stages.title: Decisions and scaffold
stages.goal: Settle the specification decisions that block Basic, and create the project skeleton.
stages.exit: All S0 tasks done: blocking Basic decisions recorded in the specification, AGENTS.md local to this directory in place, and an empty Worker deployed manually.

stages.title: Attestation core
stages.goal: Implement the attestation format, canonical serialization, signing, validity and the shared test vectors.
stages.exit: Vector set v1 passes in CI, including malformed, expired, tampered and unknown-algorithm cases.

stages.title: Issuance (Basic)
stages.goal: Implement issuance with proof of possession, role validation, replay protection and enrollment.
stages.exit: A test client obtains a valid attestation; bad proof of possession, replayed nonces and out-of-list roles are rejected.

stages.title: Verification and revocation (Basic)
stages.goal: Provide the verifier library and the revocation list, failing closed everywhere.
stages.exit: The verifier rejects every unverifiable case and revocation takes effect within the published interval.

stages.title: Integration and Basic conformance
stages.goal: Prove the Basic profile end to end against controller and router stand-ins and cut a Basic candidate.
stages.exit: Basic conformance suite green, deviations documented, candidate tagged.

stages.title: Standard profile
stages.goal: Add non-exportable keys, real-time revocation, rotation and metadata publication.
stages.exit: Standard conformance suite green on the chosen key host.

stages.title: Identity binding and audit
stages.goal: Implement identity binding and the signed audit trail.
stages.exit: Binding and audit conformance tests green for the profiles that require them.

stages.title: High profile
stages.goal: Add hardware-backed keys and a verifiable High claim.
stages.exit: High conformance suite green, profile claim independently verifiable.

stages.title: Release hardening
stages.goal: Run full conformance per profile, regenerate specifications and release.
stages.exit: Release tagged with deviations and unsupported features documented.
